freeze_note: Frozen 352 logical schedules for E01 2^3 factorial exact-binding ablation. Includes 256 adversarial/negative schedules across 8 families (32 per family) and 96 clean positive controls across 12 clinical contexts. Evaluated across all 8 factorial arms (B000-B111) yielding 2,816 total executions.
